items.question: Is 1145Hz Player the same as LSI Player?
items.answer: Yes. 1145Hz Player is the public name of the media player project that earlier LSI material calls LSI Player. They are one product.

items.question: Where can I download it?
items.answer: There is no download yet. When a release is approved it will be listed on the Downloads page with its version, platform, file size and checksum.

items.question: Will voice control work on my device?
items.answer: That has not been confirmed. Voice features will only be promised on platforms where a release states they are implemented.
